subtitle: 침낭 퀘 안내하다 돌라나르까지 왕복한 썰

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
저기, 서부 몰락지대서
그 침낭은 뭐예요?
cuts.visual_prompt: High-angle comic cut on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal Westfall golden grass touch. On the left, cute 2.5-head chibi SD Dwarf Hunter (she/her, gun holstered on back) lounges cozily inside a warm beige-brown medieval quilted wool sleeping bag with leather straps, with her cute 2.5-head chibi SD baby brown bear cub curled up beside her. On the right, cute 2.5-head chibi SD Night Elf Priest (she/her, staff holstered on back) leans down curiously with hands clasped together.

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.dialogue:
뉴비한테 딱 좋은 퀘!
소라딘 성벽까지 가자~
cuts.visual_prompt: Side-profile walking shot left-to-right on a pure #FFFFFF background with a minimal dusty road line. Leading on the left, cute 2.5-head chibi SD Dwarf Hunter (she/her, gun holstered on back) marches energetically pointing ahead with her cute 2.5-head chibi SD baby brown bear cub trotting happily beside her. Trailing on the right, cute 2.5-head chibi SD Night Elf Priest (she/her, staff holstered on back) hurries to keep up with tired sweat drops.

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind cute 2.5-head chibi SD Dwarf Hunter on the left (she/her, gun holstered on back) holding up a smooth oval blue-swirling-rune Hearthstone, with her cute 2.5-head chibi SD baby brown bear cub peeking beside her. Facing her on the right, cute 2.5-head chibi SD Night Elf Priest (she/her, staff holstered on back) tilts her head sheepishly while holding her own glowing blue-swirl Hearthstone.

Extreme close-up bust-up shock freeze-frame filling 80 percent of the frame height on a pure #FFFFFF background. Cute 2.5-head chibi SD Dwarf Hunter (she/her) freezes deadpan in stunned disbelief with wide blank white eyes, jaw dropped, and tiny sweat drops, while her cute 2.5-head chibi SD baby brown bear cub peeks up beside her cheek mirroring the exact same shocked wide-eyed stare.

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.visual_prompt: Side-profile walking shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on pure #FFFFFF background with minimal dirt path and a purple Night Elf street lantern: left, exhausted half-lidded Dwarf Hunter (rifle slung on back) sighing while leading Night Elf Priest by the hand as her cute baby brown bear cub trots happily between them. Right, cheerful Night Elf Priest waving excitedly with her single golden cross staff strapped neatly across her back (one staff only).

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.dialogue:
내가 미쳤지…
대체 뭐에 취했던 거지?
cuts.visual_prompt: Low-angle resting shot on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal stone wall touch. On the right, cute 2.5-head chibi SD Night Elf Priest (she/her, staff laid aside) beams joyfully snuggled inside her brand-new warm beige-brown medieval quilted wool sleeping bag. On the left, cute 2.5-head chibi SD Dwarf Hunter (she/her, gun laid aside) lies completely flat inside her sleeping bag staring blankly upward with her cute 2.5-head chibi SD baby brown bear cub fast asleep on her tummy.
